tradingCopilot.title: Trading Copilot
tradingCopilot.description: AI-powered trading copilot offering real-time market insights and intelligent assistance for informed trading decisions.

aiEmployeeWorkspace.title: AI Employee Workspace Automation
aiEmployeeWorkspace.description: Read-only Google Workspace briefing automation powered by GitHub Actions, generating daily executive Markdown reports from Calendar, Gmail, and Drive.

shopifyAutomation.title: Shopify Business Intelligence Automation
shopifyAutomation.description: A read-only Shopify business intelligence workflow that generates a daily Markdown report from order and inventory data. Calculates operational metrics, flags low-stock products, and optionally uses an OpenAI-compatible model for aggregate business analysis. Runs automatically through a scheduled GitHub Actions workflow with privacy-first, read-only API access.

agenticAIOS.title: Agentic AI OS
agenticAIOS.description: Agentic AI OS is a platform for building AI workflows in minutes. It offers AI-powered tools including an intelligent Read assistant, a Workflow Generator, and Diagram visualization to design and build agentic AI solutions with ease.

photoToSketch.title: AI Photo to Sketch Converter
photoToSketch.description: AI Photo to Sketch Converter is an AI-powered web application built with Streamlit that transforms your photos into artistic pencil sketches using computer vision and image processing techniques.

loopEngineering.title: Loop Engineering Hub
loopEngineering.description: The Complete Loop Engineering Hub — from manual prompting to autonomous AI agent systems. An educational repository teaching how to design automated loops that prompt AI coding agents, covering heartbeat types, the maker-checker pattern, memory spines, and observability across 12 hands-on projects. The important skill has moved from writing prompts to designing loops.

worldMap.title: World Map
worldMap.description: World Map is an interactive Streamlit web application for data visualization and geographic exploration, allowing users to explore and interact with global map data.
